_comment: Allowlist for live web search. Edited as data, not code — add a marketplace
or forum here and the research agent can reach it on the next run.
The provider caps search_domain_filter at 20 entries, so keep the enabled
set under that. Anything listed in research/config.py BLOCKED_SOURCES must
drive2.ru is deliberately absent: its robots.txt is a blanket Disallow with
named blocks on GPTBot, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot.

manual_specs was added after measuring that a live search finds the official OEM manual PDF (e.g. techinfo.honda.com) in ~1.4s for any vehicle, while the local corpus covered 8 makes and produced four provenance bugs (French manual, cross-make fallback, motorcycle contamination, mislabeled source). Web search is now the primary manual path; data/manuals is a cache.

services group added for the 'who do I take it to' step. manual_specs and manuals groups removed with the manual tooling. NOTE: this file is now only read by url_allowed() - it is a SCRAPE permission list, not a search config. Search scoping lives in _PARTS_PASSES / _SERVICE_PASSES in web.py.

armenian_market.description: Local listings and dealers — parts availability and local pricing

regional_parts.description: Where Armenian buyers actually source parts: Russia and Georgia

services.description: Where to find a workshop once the part is known. turn.am is an Armenian services marketplace with a /category/car-services section; spyur.am is the national business directory. Both allow User-agent: * in robots.txt.
